tree: Charles Kantor and Laurent Sifre, co-founders of Twinlink, announce the appointment of Gautier Cloix as Chief Executive Officer.
Gautier, formerly CEO France at Palantir, joins H to scale commercial operations with major enterprise customers across Europe and worldwide, following the successful launch of H's products.
His go-to-market expertise will reinforce H's ambition to make its AI agents the global standard for enterprises.
The founders remain fully committed: Laurent remains CTO, and Charles remains an important shareholder and will continue to be involved in H's journey as such.
